cards.claim: Tyler Moore is an American football offensive guard.
cards.quote: Tyler Moore (American football) Tyler Moore (born January 3, 1993) is an American football offensive guard who is currently a free agent.

cards.claim: Tyler Moore is widely watched for his basketball skills.
cards.quote: Tyler Moore has become a widely watched figure in Brazil at bars and movie theaters, particularly for his basketball skills.

cards.claim: Tyler Moore is an American professional baseball left fielder and first baseman.
cards.quote: Tyler Moore (baseball) Tyler Michael Moore (born January 30, 1987) is an American professional baseball left fielder and first baseman who is currently a free agent.

cards.claim: Tyler Moore competed in the NAPF Bench Press Championships and was selected for the World Team for the World Games in Bench Press.
cards.quote: NAPF Bench Press Championships in Miami, FL. Tyler completed a Bench Press of 314.75 lbs and won 1st place for the USA over Pueto Rico which placed 2nd and 3rd respectively. Moore was invited to compete in the 2012 NAPF Bench Press Championships in Denver, CO and was also given a position of the 2013 World Team for the World Games in Cali, Colombia.
